bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; prohibiting acquiring state land at auction; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 94.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[94.56] PROHIBITION ON ACQUIRING LAND AT AUCTION. +]

[+Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, the commissioner of natural resources may not acquire real property at auction or accept real property that was acquired by a third party at auction. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; prohibiting acquiring state land at auction; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 94.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[94.56] PROHIBITION ON ACQUIRING LAND AT AUCTION.

Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, the commissioner of natural resources may not acquire real property at auction or accept real property that was acquired by a third party at auction.
additions: [94.56] PROHIBITION ON ACQUIRING LAND AT AUCTION.

Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, the commissioner of natural resources may not acquire real property at auction or accept real property that was acquired by a third party at auction.
